name: Leadlight
desc: The frame is re-glazed — a came net is laid over it and every pane takes the colour of whatever sits behind it, pulled toward its own bottle-glass tint and streaked with reamy texture, while a light moves slowly outside the window and fires each pane in turn as it passes.

energy.doc: how hard the light outside fires the glass, plus the came lip and net breathing

density.doc: number of panes in the net

glass.doc: how far each pane pulls the scene toward its own glass tint (0 clear glazing that just shows the frame, 1 fully coloured glass)

alpha.doc: opacity of the glazing over the scene

scale.doc: rose diameter and the size of the light falling outside

spread.doc: how far the pane tints scatter either side of hue (0 a single-colour window, 360 the full jewel box)

style.doc: aesthetic: irregular jewel-toned cathedral glazing in heavy black came / restrained domestic diamond quarries, pale glass and thin lead / a radial rose window with an open boss / abstract glazier's cutline — the net as a cyan working drawing over an almost untouched frame

act.doc: multi-minute program: sun tracks steadily across the outside / vespers crawls a low hard light along the window over minutes / storm hurries the light and agitates the net
